notes.title: Alicia’s New Look 😍😍😍
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/28a1dfde7b98b9e06ee59021ff2b0b257c95c30b.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Alicia’s new look, chosen by vote! 😍😍😍[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3]Hey everyone! If you remember, last month on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You/?curator_clanid=41585176" style="button"][u][b]Summer for You[/b][/u][/url] page, we held a poll to choose the best look for our unforgettable, gorgeous, and super-sexy little witch Alicia! 🥰[/h3][p][/p][h3]Based on the voting results, we realized that the new design we created for Memories with You was very poorly received. So, armed with fresh creativity, we decided to completely redesign her! And now we’re ready to present her to you![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/ff4dd2744c5cc7cd0c844103ab48e5c408a96303.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Please share your thoughts in the comments — what do you think of this radical redesign, and do you like it? 🥰🥰🥰[/h3][p][/p][h2][b]Also, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist if you haven’t already![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576110/Memories_with_You/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/86a3d8a18e3d1cd7cd327e3feef02a54658ce3f7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS CANCELLED 😭😭😭
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/772eda425f3cb1da1a93f898e979f5655b1e9c61.png"][/img][/p][h1]Steam moderator did not approve our game for Early Access...[/h1][h1][/h1][h3]Hi everyone! We have some sad news to share... Our main project, *Memories with You*, was rejected from Early Access by the platform's moderator, who claims that games of this kind (adult content games) are not allowed in Early Access by Valve. HOWEVER! Initially, we were approved for Early Access, and during the first build review (which we failed for other specific reasons), nothing of the sort was mentioned! Moreover, this moderator provided no evidence to support their claim—no link to a relevant rule or policy, nor any other form of official justification.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Here's a screenshot of the moderator’s response:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/552a4c9861ebd4c7b7acee43e303eceb508a739a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Unfortunately, we had no choice but to comply. Support hasn't responded, and the review process took over 12 days before ending in rejection.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]However, we're not giving up! We're simply finishing the game as planned. Soon (and assuming we get a reasonable and understanding moderator next time), we’ll release a demo version and are already preparing to submit the final build for launch![/h3][h3][/h3][h3]We sincerely hope for your support—please like, comment, and, of course, add the game to your wishlists! It means the world to us.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/fd2e3c0cdad76835174956b713d9c2a3203a58f0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DEVLOG #4
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/fb32136562cb512dd9066502daa727b54c26f6a7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hi all! And this is another Devlog with the characters of Memories for You! The next in line is The brisk Jane![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Jane is a dominant, strong girl. She only accepts those who really try - losers do not bother her (by losers she means those who have given up). Jane with her whole appearance evokes a sense of challenge and a slight feeling of subordination to a strong woman.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]With her stubbornness, fortitude and recalcitrance, Jane always gets what she wants in the end. She is very patient if she sees the point in trying, but she is rather harsh, closed and cold. Only someone she really likes can reveal her sweet and feminine side![/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Below you can see the parameters of our fitness girl:[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/6c5b924ef21a7a9cb4d64d2e293187c5d0734d4c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][u]Also, don't forget to add our upcoming games to your wishlist:[/u][/h1][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576130/CYBER_RONIN_Lust/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576330/Hentai_Tavern/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: DEVLOG #3
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/739c8a0c55a3dcc03f69b294e47fa8f5c924a079.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hi all! And this is another Devlog with the characters of Memories for You! The next in line is the extravagant Frida![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Frida is a bright, bold, open, sincere and kind girl. As a real punk, she can do anything – any walls (and metaphorical ones too) can be passed through, if only there was a suitable crowbar![/h3][h3][/h3][h3]She can do anything. Passion, will to live and optimism plunge her problems and ill-wishers into panic. However, because of her straightforwardness and harshness, people often misunderstand her. This, alas, leads to conflicts.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Below you can see the parameters of our punk girl:[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/934c40592fe7ea4aea4a4b01995b7385be2c8de8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][u]Also, don't forget to add our upcoming games to your wishlist:[/u][/h1][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576130/CYBER_RONIN_Lust/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576330/Hentai_Tavern/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/061b5720cde0855fc317fc3707b564d869d69192.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hello everyone! Today we begin to introduce you to the characters of Memories for You - the demoness Arlequin![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Arlequin is an evil demoness who came from Hell itself to mock the main character and then take his soul. At first, she pretends to be a virtuous woman, while causing questions and a feeling that something is not right here. Later, these feelings can change to annoyance and anger.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Arlequin is capable of many things thanks to magic and her own lack of principles. However, for a demon, she is rather short-sighted. She loves souls, enslavement and herself. She does not like it when people interfere with her, does not like to lose, and also does not like mortals (or so she thinks).[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]We invite you to get to know our demoness better![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/9368cdc532e682ab94957ceba316fafae856fa0b.png"][/img][/p][h1][u]Also, don't forget to add our upcoming games to your wishlist:[/u][/h1][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576130/CYBER_RONIN_Lust/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576330/Hentai_Tavern/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: DEVLOG #1
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/e2d0a958abe6b390c51e84415ffa65c1cdcb1231.png"][/img][/p][h1]Hello everyone! Today we introduce you to our girl from [u][b]Memories with You[/b][/u] named Michelle![/h1][h1][/h1][h3]Michelle is a sweet girl, innocent and romantic, who works at the hospital. She exudes sweetness and tenderness. She loves sweets and cute little things like pendants.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Michelle is so sweet that she is simply incapable of making enemies. She always gets embarrassed, and even gets angry in a charming way. Because of this, patients often do not take her seriously, and neither do the people around her.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]We suggest taking a closer look at our sweet girl![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662058/7193af7c00fdb2a76cccfc0ce1a09e576f3d995c.png"][/img][/p][h2][b][u]ADD THE GAME TO YOUR WISHLISTS![/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576110/Memories_with_You/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
